method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 翻找食品柜，找出一瓶快喝完的像样威士忌，给两人各倒一杯。
facts.anchor: digs farther into the pantry and locates a mostly empty bottle of decent whiskey.

facts.fact: Wendy 后悔那天送 Julian 去上学，因为他比平常更沉默寡言。
facts.anchor: I never should have sent him to school today. He was so reserved.

facts.fact: Wendy 说 Graner 家的孩子午饭后把 Julian 跟进了洗手间。
facts.anchor: The Graner kid followed him into a bathroom after lunch.

facts.fact: Wendy 说剪刀来自美术课，是老师的、不是安全剪刀，又大又锋利。
facts.anchor: they think it was from art class. They’re the teacher’s—not the safety kind. Big and sharp.

facts.fact: Julian 用剪刀刺中 Bastion 肩膀，伤口很深，几乎穿透。
facts.anchor: He stabbed him in the shoulder, and it went deep. Almost all the way through.

facts.fact: Kevin 说服当局让 Julian 回家而非关进 Portland 的少管所；Bastion 父母震怒，准备起诉索赔。
facts.anchor: They were going to hold him at a delinquency center in Portland, but Kevin managed to convince the authorities to let him come home.

facts.fact: Wendy 看到 Julian 腿上的瘀伤，听信了他“从石头上摔下来”的说法。
facts.anchor: The bruises. On his legs. He told me he fell on the rocks, and I believed him.

facts.fact: Wendy 说她们来找 Hattie 前当天已联系了三位心理治疗师。
facts.anchor: We called three today before I came over.

facts.fact: Hattie 承认自己当年忽视了儿子的求救信号、以为“是生活太忙”，并说这害死了他。
facts.anchor: There were warning signs, and I ignored them. He was crying out for help, and I was too caught up in life to understand what I was seeing. I didn’t want to see. And it killed him.
